comments.author: LadyGaKa
comments.body:
Donation Appreciation Exchange Ticket (No.1)

You can obtain the following (by random) :

1. Tuna Olive Steak (1)
2. Large Ship Blueprint: Part (1)
3. World Languages Reader (1)
4. Renegotiation demand (1)
5. Original Ship Permit (1)
6. Ceasefire Agreement (1)
7. Shipwright's Emergency Repair Tools (1)
8. Navy Dispatch Request (1)

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Cash, you got this if you joined Agent and go to City Official (preferably any port that allied with your nation but i think you can do in other city as well), there's a new button for Commercial License that lets you invest and you will get this item.

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Looks like you can invest only once each day.
